summary: ```markdown # CLO 2024.2 - Printing Emissions - Material Distribution ## Optimizing Basic Settings From this version, we have optimized the functions related to the basic settings. We can add correct sewing information to the version and then switch to the print and release mode. Click on the fabric in the object window and set the width in the property editor. Similarly, you can also modify the width in the material settings. ## Setting Length and Units You can also manually set the length of the sale price, so that the version can be calculated based on the length of the setting. Additionally, you can modify the unit here, and we can further set the direction of the material as double. You can also change the length of the material according to the needed length of the fabric. ## Configuring Clothing Quantities We can set the number of clothing items that you need to choose—one or four—to calculate the material. We can also set the space between the fabric pieces to be in place. Furthermore, we can set the number of clothes that need to be arms here. ## Calculating Material Costs When 3D clothing is out, we can calculate the unit number of the machine horse and estimate the material cost in a single row format. In the current scene, we can directly enter the current size of the clothing number. After entering three keys here, we can proceed to the next steps. ## Layout Settings After completing the layout setting, we can click the plate layout button to start the layout. When the progress bar is close to 100% and the layout picture is no longer changing, you can click here to stop the layout calculation. After the layout is completed, we can see the fabric name displayed at the top of the layout area, along with the direction of the sand line and the number of plates placed in the current layout area. ## Fabric Information Display The name of the file is displayed on the left side, with the length and volume of the material, and the width and volume of the fabric displayed on the right side, as well as the number of keys. We can also find this information in the property editor. ## Improved Fabric Arrangement In the previous version, we needed to select different fabrics to arrange them separately. However, in this version, when we switch to different fabrics, we can see that other fabrics have also been arranged. When you need to rearrange, you can reset the arrangement settings and then click to remove the extra fabric sheets to delete the excess sheets, allowing for a more efficient fabric operation. ## 3D Riding Suit Calculations When the 3D riding suit is finished, we can also calculate the number of mixed-race fabrics in the print and release mode. In the property editor of the single machine, select the riding button on the right side of the number of clothes. Enter the number of each size keys that need to be lined in the spring. We can enter the total number of clothes at the top. ## Modifying Size Keys Click to enter the value and quickly modify the number of size keys. If we need to set the number of each size key according to the scale, you can also modify the S and XL numbers here as one key. We can also select to divide the clothes according to the size of each size. This is a new function we added this time. ## Selecting Lining Colors Next, we will choose the color that needs to be lined. If you only need to line the current color, you can choose the current color. You can also choose the color according to your needs. Click to select the color button on the right side of the color, and click to select the color information in the spring. The color that is selected will be lined together when lining. ## Finalizing the Lining Process Now you can see that the lining has been completed. When we open the display to show the code in random colors, you can see clearly that the version is divided into different size versions according to the size of the horse. Close the display to put the code in random colors. When we switch the horse, the position of the current horse version will be highlighted. ## Displaying Patterns Switching the flag color will show that the selected flag color has been lined together. If you want to display the pattern, you can click on the quick photo. After setting the size of the pattern according to the needs and the information that needs to be displayed, click to save, and you can save the file to this machine. ## Conclusion I hope this video can help you better understand the function update content and application scenarios of this print and print feature. Make your print and print operation more flexible and smooth. Hurry up and open the software and try it out! ```
